description: Land Acquisition - Bandiyamulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that specific land parcels are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations, making it clearly focused on land and property matters rather than government personnel changes or other administrative categories.
